text:
Noah Ark FC and Edunz FC Thursday recorded impressive victories at the Ikorodu DFA of the ongoing Senator Oluremi Tinubu/APC Unity Cup.
Powered by Hon. Tajudeen Ajide, the football competition continues to provide a platform for young footballers to showcase their abilities while reinforcing the message of unity through football.
Both teams secured identical 2-1 victories in their respective Match Day Three fixtures.
Noah Ark FC emerged victorious in the opening fixture, defeating Adhoc FA 2-1 in an entertaining contest.
The victory underlined Noah Ark’s determination to make a strong impression in the tournament, as they successfully negotiated a challenging encounter to claim maximum points.
Adhoc FA, despite their efforts, could not find a way back into the game, allowing Noah Ark to celebrate an important victory.
In the other encounter, Edunz FC also produced a 2-1 victory over Mighty Blaster FC to complete a successful Match Day Three for the winning teams.
The result ensured that Edunz FC joined Noah Ark FC in celebrating a winning outing, with both sides demonstrating their attacking quality and competitive spirit.
Wednesday’s Match Day Two fixtures also produced entertaining football, with Cottage FC recording an impressive 4-2 victory over Leaders FA.
Rebirth FA and Comfort Edge FC played out a goalless draw before Rebirth prevailed 5-4 in the penalty shootout.
Iziq FC completed the day’s action with a 2-1 victory over St. Charles Athletic FC.
